preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ ()' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string `s` contains only letters (a-z, A-Z), spaces, and parentheses '()'.

postconditions.expression: all(c not in '()' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The returned string contains no parentheses '()'.

postconditions.expression: all(c in s or c == ' ' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The returned string consists only of characters present in the original string `s` (excluding parentheses) and spaces.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for c in s if c not in '()')
postconditions.description: The length of the returned string equals the number of non-parenthesis characters in the original string `s`.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == s[j] for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(len(s)) if s[j] not in '()' and return_value[i] == s[j] and j == next((k for k in range(len(s)) if s[k] == return_value[i] and k < next((m for m in range(k+1, len(s)) if s[m] == return_value[i]), len(s))), len(s)))
postconditions.description: The returned string preserves the order of non-parenthesis characters from the original string `s`, including spaces, and removes all content (including spaces) inside any parentheses and the parentheses themselves.
